# TimelinesAI

TimelinesAI enables teams to manage and automate WhatsApp communications, integrating with various CRMs and tools to streamline workflows.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/timelinesai/.

## Actions

- **Delete File**: Delete an uploaded file by its uid.
- **Get Chat Messages** (read-only): Get messages from a specific chat in timelinesai.
- **Get Chats** (read-only): Get full or filtered list of all chats.
- **Get File Details** (read-only): Retrieve metadata and temporary download url for an uploaded file.
- **Send Message**: Send a message through timelinesai whatsapp integration.
- **Create Webhook Subscription**: Create a new webhook subscription.
- **Delete Webhook**: Delete a webhook subscription by its id.
- **Get Webhook** (read-only): Retrieve details of a specific webhook subscription.
- **Get Webhooks** (read-only): List all webhook subscriptions for the workspace.
- **Get WhatsApp Accounts** (read-only): List all whatsapp accounts connected to the workspace.
- **List Uploaded Files** (read-only): List files uploaded in your timelinesai workspace.
- **Update Webhook**: Update an existing webhook subscription.
